name: Lucia Plugins
description: Third-party plugins for Lucia, maintained outside the core repository.

plugins.name: Flight weather
plugins.description: Paramotor and ultralight flyability check. Reads live station wind and gusts plus NWS alerts for your home area (keyless: api.weather.gov + Open-Meteo) and answers 'can I fly?' with a FLYABLE, MARGINAL, NO-GO, or NO DATA verdict against your personal wind limits.
plugins.author: zxPILEDRIVERxz

plugins.name: WeatherAPI.com Weather
plugins.description: Current conditions and multi-day forecasts via the WeatherAPI.com forecast API (temperature, rain chance, alerts, AQI, pollen). The default location resolves to your Home Assistant home coordinates, or a place you configure — and the literal word 'home' as the location always means your own house.
plugins.author: zxPILEDRIVERxz

plugins.name: Crypto Price Check
plugins.description: Live crypto prices via CoinGecko (keyless): 'What's Bitcoin at?' → one compact voice-friendly line with the price and 24h change. Knows common coins by name or ticker ('BTC', 'xrp'), accepts any CoinGecko coin id and any ISO currency code.
plugins.author: zxPILEDRIVERxz

plugins.name: House Briefing
plugins.description: 'Anything weird in the house today?' — one voice-friendly report from your Home Assistant: unreachable devices, sensors that went quiet, thermostats off target, media players stuck playing, today's calendar events, plus today's weather (Open-Meteo, keyless) in your own unit system. No setup: location, units, and time zone come from Home Assistant.
plugins.author: zxPILEDRIVERxz
